5968: function refreshFinanceTotals(){
5969:   let inv=0,rec=0,fx=0;
5970:   Object.values(window.financeData).forEach(x=>{inv+=x.invoice||0;rec+=x.received||0;fx+=x.fxClosed||0;});
5971:   const pending=inv-rec;
5972:   document.getElementById('finTotalReceivable').textContent=usd(inv);
5973:   document.getElementById('finTotalReceived').textContent=usd(rec);
5974:   document.getElementById('finTotalPending').textContent=usd(pending);
5975:   document.getElementById('finFxClosed').textContent=usd(fx);
5976: }

5978: /* AES_RECEIPT_GUARD_V2 */

5980: async function aesFinanceLoadSaved(order){
5981:   const db=window.aesSharedClient;
5982:   if(!db)throw Error('Supabase indisponível');
5983:   const {data,error}=await db.from('aes_finance_order_movements').select('*').eq('order_number',order).order('created_at',{ascending:true});
5984:   if(error)throw error;
5985:   const d=window.financeData[order];if(!d)return;
5986:   const rows=(data||[]).map(x=>({id:x.id,persisted:true,type:x.movement_type==='receipt'?'Recebimento':'Fechamento Câmbio',paymentType:x.payment_type,date:x.movement_date,amount:Number(x.amount),rate:x.exchange_rate||'—',bank:x.bank,ref:x.reference}));
5987:   // Retain only local, unpersisted entries visibly; never treat them as confirmed.
5988:   const local=[]; /* AES_RECEIPT_HISTORY_DISPLAY_V4: Supabase is authoritative */
5989:   d.history=[...rows,...local];
5990:   d.received=d.history.filter(x=>x.type==='Recebimento').reduce((n,x)=>n+Number(x.amount||0),0);
5991:   d.fxClosed=d.history.filter(x=>x.type==='Fechamento Câmbio').reduce((n,x)=>n+Number(x.amount||0),0);
5992:   if(window.currentFinanceOrder===order)refreshFinanceOrder();
5993: }
5994: async function aesFinanceSaveMovement(kind,fields,requestKey){
5995:   const db=window.aesSharedClient,order=window.currentFinanceOrder;
5996:   if(!db||!order)throw Error('Conexão Supabase ou ordem indisponível');
5997:   const {data:auth,error:authError}=await db.auth.getUser();
5998:   if(authError||!auth?.user)throw Error('Sessão expirada. Faça login novamente');
5999:   const record={order_number:order,operation_type:'export',movement_type:kind,amount:fields.amount,currency:fields.currency||'USD',movement_date:fields.date||null,bank:fields.bank||null,reference:fields.ref||null,payment_type:fields.paymentType||null,exchange_rate:fields.rate||null,created_by:auth.user.id,request_key:requestKey};
6000:   /* AES_RECEIPT_INSERT_FIX_V3 */
6001:   const {data,error}=await db.from('aes_finance_order_movements').insert(record).select().single();
6002:   if(error)throw error;
6003:   if(!data?.id)throw Error('Supabase não confirmou o registro');
6004:   const {data:verified,error:verifyError}=await db.from('aes_finance_order_movements').select('id,order_number,amount').eq('id',data.id).single();
6005:   if(verifyError||!verified||verified.order_number!==order)throw Error('Registro inserido, mas a confirmação de leitura falhou; verifique o histórico antes de tentar novamente');
6006:   return data;
6007: }
6008: function openFinanceOrder(order,importer,invoice){

6017:   refreshFinanceOrder();

6020: function closeFinanceOrder(){ document.getElementById('financeOrderWorkspace').style.display='none'; }
6021: function refreshFinanceOrder(){
6022:   const o=window.currentFinanceOrder, d=window.financeData[o]; if(!d) return; if(!d.hedges)d.hedges=[];
6023:   const bal=Math.max((d.invoice||0)-(d.received||0),0);
6024:   document.getElementById('finOrderBalance').value=usd(bal);
6025:   const recEl=document.getElementById('finReceived-'+o), pendEl=document.getElementById('finPending-'+o);
6026:   const st=document.getElementById('finStatus-'+o);
6027:   const fxEl=document.getElementById('finFxClosed-'+o), fxPendEl=document.getElementById('finFxPending-'+o);
6028:   const fxSt=document.getElementById('finFxStatus-'+o);
6029:   if(recEl) recEl.textContent=usd(d.received);
6030:   if(pendEl) pendEl.textContent=usd(bal);
6031:   if(st && st.tagName!=='SELECT'){
6032:     if(bal<=0){st.textContent='Received';st.className='badge good';}
6033:     else if((d.received||0)>0){st.textContent='Partial';st.className='badge warn';}
6034:     else {st.textContent='Pending';st.className='badge bad';}
6035:   }
6036:   const fxPending=Math.max((d.invoice||0)-(d.fxClosed||0),0);
6037:   if(fxEl) fxEl.textContent=usd(d.fxClosed);
6038:   if(fxPendEl) fxPendEl.textContent=usd(fxPending);
6039:   if(fxSt){
6040:     if(fxPending<=0){fxSt.textContent='Closed';fxSt.className='badge good';}
6041:     else if((d.fxClosed||0)>0){fxSt.textContent='Partial';fxSt.className='badge warn';}
6042:     else {fxSt.textContent='Open';fxSt.className='badge bad';}
6043:   }
6044:   renderFinanceHistory();
6045:   refreshFinanceTotals();
6046: }
6047: async function saveFinanceReceipt(){
6048:   const order=window.currentFinanceOrder;
6049:   const amount=Number(getVal('finReceiptAmount')||0);
6050:   if(!order||!(amount>0)||!Number.isFinite(amount)){notify('Informe ordem e valor válido.');return;}
6051:   if(aesReceiptPending.has(order)){notify('Aguarde a confirmação do lançamento anterior.');return;}
6052:   const button=document.querySelector('[onclick="saveFinanceReceipt()"]');
6053:   const requestKey=crypto.randomUUID();
6054:   aesReceiptPending.add(order);if(button)button.disabled=true;
6055:   try{
6056:     await aesFinanceSaveMovement('receipt',{amount,date:getVal('finReceiptDate'),bank:getVal('finReceiptBank'),ref:getVal('finReceiptRef'),paymentType:getVal('finReceiptType'),currency:getVal('finReceiptCurrency')},requestKey);
6057:     await aesFinanceLoadSaved(order);
6058:     notify('Recebimento gravado e confirmado no Supabase.');
6059:   }catch(e){
6060:     notify('ERRO: recebimento NÃO confirmado. '+e.message);
6061:   }finally{
6062:     aesReceiptPending.delete(order);if(button)button.disabled=false;
6063:   }
6064: }

10852: <script>
10853: /* Financeiro: append trader purchase and resale to the existing export orders. */
10854: (()=>{
10855:  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
10856:  let busy=false;
10857:  const num=x=>Number(x)||0;
10858:  const money=(v,c)=>String(c||'USD')+' '+num(v).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
10859:  const add=(tr,v)=>{const td=tr.insertCell();td.textContent=String(v??'—');return td};
10860:  async function refresh(){
10861:   const client=window.aesSharedClient,body=$('financeTable')?.tBodies[0];
10862:   if(!client||!body||busy)return;
10863:   busy=true;
10864:   try{
10865:    const [result,companiesResult]=await Promise.all([
10866:     client.from('aes_trader_deals').select('*').range(0,1999),
10867:     client.from('companies').select('id,name').range(0,1999)
10868:    ]);
10869:    if(result.error)throw result.error;
10870:    const names=new Map((companiesResult.data||[]).map(x=>[String(x.id),x.name]));
10871:    const fragment=document.createDocumentFragment();
10872:    for(const deal of result.data||[]){
10873:     if(deal.sale_flow?.operation_kind==='broker'||deal.status==='cancelled')continue;
10874:     for(const [kind,flow,label] of [['purchase',deal.purchase_flow,'COMPRA'],['sale',deal.sale_flow,'REVENDA']]){
10875:      const commercial=flow?.commercial||{},parties=flow?.parties||{};
10876:      const qty=num(commercial.quantity??deal.quantity),price=num(commercial.unit_price??(kind==='purchase'?deal.purchase_unit_price:deal.sale_unit_price));
10877:      const total=qty*price,paid=(Array.isArray(flow?.payments)?flow.payments:[]).reduce((a,p)=>a+num(p.amount),0),balance=Math.max(0,total-paid);
10878:      const id=kind==='purchase'?(parties.exporter||deal.supplier_id):(parties.importer||deal.buyer_id);
10879:      const party=names.get(String(id))||'—';
10880:      const tr=document.createElement('tr');tr.dataset.financeTrader='1';tr.dataset.kind=kind;tr.dataset.order=deal.trade_number||'';tr.dataset.importer=party;tr.dataset.status=balance<=0&&total>0?'Received':paid>0?'Partial':'Pending';tr.dataset.fx='Open';
10881:      const first=add(tr,deal.trade_number||'—');const tag=document.createElement('div');tag.className='badge '+(kind==='purchase'?'warn':'info');tag.textContent=kind==='purchase'?'COMPRA · A PAGAR':'REVENDA · A RECEBER';tag.classList.add('aes-fin-mini-kind');first.append(tag);
10882:      add(tr,'—');add(tr,commercial.product||deal.product||'—');add(tr,party);add(tr,'—');
10883:      [total,paid,balance,balance].forEach(v=>add(tr,money(v,deal.currency)));
10884:      add(tr,'—');add(tr,'—');
10885:      // Situação editável, independente para COMPRA e REVENDA.
10886:      const statusTd=tr.insertCell();
10887:      const statusControl=document.createElement('select');
10888:      statusControl.setAttribute('aria-label','Situação financeira '+(deal.trade_number||'')+' '+label);
10889:      statusControl.style.minWidth='135px';
10890:      for(const [v,txt] of [['Pending','Pendente'],['Partial','Parcial'],['Received','Recebido'],['Financiamento RTS','Financiamento RTS']]) statusControl.add(new Option(txt,v));
10891:      const statusStorageKey='aes-trader-finance-status:'+deal.id+':'+kind;
10892:      let savedStatus='';try{savedStatus=localStorage.getItem(statusStorageKey)||'';}catch(_e){}
10893:      statusControl.value=['Pending','Partial','Received','Financiamento RTS'].includes(savedStatus)?savedStatus:tr.dataset.status;
10894:      tr.dataset.status=statusControl.value;
10895:      statusControl.addEventListener('change',()=>{
10896:        tr.dataset.status=statusControl.value;
10897:        try{localStorage.setItem(statusStorageKey,statusControl.value);}catch(_e){}
10898:        window.filterFinance?.();
10899:      });
10900:      statusTd.append(statusControl);
10901:      const action=tr.insertCell(),button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='btn primary';button.textContent='Abrir';button.onclick=()=>{
10902:        // Abrir o mesmo formulário financeiro dos contratos de exportação.
10903:        // Chave exclusiva por operação para não misturar COMPRA e REVENDA.
10904:        const financeKey='TRADER:'+deal.id+':'+kind;
10905:        const existing=window.financeData?.[financeKey];
10906:        const previousPayments=Array.isArray(flow?.payments)?flow.payments:[];
10907:        if(!window.financeData)window.financeData={};
10908:        if(!existing){
10909:          window.financeData[financeKey]={invoice:total,received:paid,fxClosed:0,history:previousPayments.map(p=>({type:kind==='purchase'?'Pagamento Compra':'Recebimento Revenda',date:p.date||p.payment_date||'',amount:num(p.amount),rate:'—',bank:p.bank||'',ref:p.reference||''})),hedges:[]};
10910:        }else{existing.invoice=total;}
10911:        window.openFinanceOrder(financeKey,party,total);
10912:        const title=$('finOrderTitle'),orderInput=$('finOrder');
10913:        if(title)title.textContent=(deal.trade_number||'—')+' · '+label;
10914:        if(orderInput)orderInput.value=(deal.trade_number||'—')+' · '+label;
10915:        const subtitle=$('finImporterTitle');if(subtitle)subtitle.textContent=party+' · '+(kind==='purchase'?'A PAGAR':'A RECEBER');
10916:        const balanceLabel=document.querySelector('label[for="finOrderBalance"]');
10917:        if(balanceLabel)balanceLabel.textContent=kind==='purchase'?'Saldo a Pagar':'Saldo a Receber';
10918:        $('financeOrderWorkspace')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
10919:      };action.append(button);fragment.append(tr);
10920:     }
10921:    }
10922:    body.querySelectorAll('[data-finance-trader="1"]').forEach(x=>x.remove());
10923:    body.append(fragment);
10924:    window.filterFinance?.();
10925:   }catch(error){console.error('Falha ao carregar Compra e Revenda:',error);window.notify?.('Não foi possível carregar Compra e Revenda: '+error.message)}finally{busy=false}
10926:  }
10927:  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
